analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (89,060 KRW) vs SMA5 (93,781 KRW) / SMA20 (105,680 KRW) / SMA50 (105,864 KRW): indicating short-to-medium term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 (115,105 KRW) / SMA200 (99,302 KRW): indicating long-term trend weakness, in a bearish phase.
· 52-week position (36.7%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.5→27.5): entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-327.0548→-2566.2707): bearish expansion, worsening after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 90,336 KRW): approaching lower band, with band width widening to 29.04%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (82,500 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (78,177 KRW) and 20-day low (85,670 KRW).
· Swing resistance (89,550 KRW): a level with significant decline from the 5-day high (105,290 KRW).
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low): indicating continuation of the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.26x): indicating moderate confidence in recent price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): maintaining a wait-and-see approach until trend reversal signals are confirmed.
